integrity: The claim is proved directly from the published Sin-G and New X–Lindley formulas. The 2019 source is credited for its stronger-than-title general hazard asymptotic, and numerical checks are used only for replay, not as proof.
scientific_limitations: The IFR-preservation theorem is one-directional; no converse is asserted.
The terminal level \(2\xi\) is already implied by the 2019 general Sin-G hazard asymptotic; the new tail statement is the first-order gap.
No inferential uncertainty statement for estimated hazards is claimed.
An unindexed equivalent IFR-preservation observation cannot be excluded.
title: The SNXL hazard is strictly increasing with a sharp \(2/z\) terminal gap
